weaknesses: The abstract does not sufficiently highlight the limitations of the proposed IRS method, particularly regarding its performance with varying values of sigma.
The paper lacks a comprehensive comparison with existing incremental certification methods, which would provide context for the claimed improvements.
The experimental setup does not include a diverse range of datasets beyond CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, limiting the generalizability of the results.
strengths: The introduction of the Incremental Randomized Smoothing (IRS) method is a novel contribution that addresses a significant gap in the certification of modified DNNs.
The empirical results demonstrate substantial speedup in certification time, with up to 4.1x improvement, providing strong evidence of the method's efficiency.
The paper is well-structured, with clear explanations of the methodology and insights derived from the experiments.
